title: Ukuzithoba Okukhulu KoMbusi
intro: Uzifumana ukwilizwe lemimangaliso yamandulo kunye nesityhilelo esinzulu. Umlawuli onamandla, ejongene nesimemo esingalindelekanga, waqalisa uhambo oluya kutshintsha indlela yekamva lakhe kunye nokholo lwabantu bakhe. Ungamtyhila na lo mntu ubalaseleyo?
clues: Ndalawula ubukumkani obuchumileyo, obuhonjiswe ngobutyebi obukhulu netrone eqaqambileyo.
Mna nabantu bam sasinqula umzimba wasezulwini, sikholelwa ukuba yiNkosi yethu, nangona ndandinamathandabuzo entliziyweni yam.
Umthunywa ongaqhelekanga, intaka, wandithumelela ileta, endibiza mna nabantu bam ukuba sizithobe kuThixo omnye.
Ndibuzise kubacebisi bam, ababenamandla amakhulu, malunga nendlela yokusabela kwesi sigidimi singazange sibonwe ngaphambili.
Ndagqiba ekubeni ndithumele isipho esixabisekileyo kulowo undithumelele ileta, ndinethemba lokuvavanya amandla neenjongo zakhe.
Ndakufika, ndamangaliswa sibhotwe esinomgangatho owenziwe ngeglasi, sibonakala njengechibi lamanzi, kwaye kulapho ndavakalisa khona ukuzithoba kwam kwiNkosi yendalo yonke.
arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verse: Indeed, I found a woman ruling them and she has been given of every thing and for her (is) a throne great (23) (27:23)
